analysis.summary: Sagittarius video outro/title card featuring close-up portrait of the auburn-haired centaur character with animated golden 'Sagittarius' title text. The warm, inviting expression and golden forest lighting create an appealing end card that encapsulates the sign's optimistic, adventurous spirit.

frames.text: Close-up portrait of the auburn-haired Sagittarius character with warm smile. 'Sagittarius' text in elegant golden script overlaid at bottom of frame. Soft forest bokeh background with golden light. Title card composition.

Same portrait composition with the golden 'Sagittarius' title text. The young man's freckled face and genuine smile capture the sign's optimistic nature. Backlit by warm forest light creating a halo effect on his curly hair.

Clean portrait without text overlay - the auburn-haired character with bright smile against forest backdrop. Full warmth and charisma of the Sagittarius persona on display. Suitable for end card or thumbnail.
